title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O challenges the Sprinters Stakes for a second time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She asks Nishino Flower to visit her waiting room, where she declares that this will be her victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both of them are confident in their speed. In a match that almost feels like destiny, the two Umamusume get ready to fight fair and square!
